title: Anderson Localization for Schrödinger Operators with Monotone Potentials Generated by the Doubling Map
summary: In this paper, we consider the Schrödinger operators on $ \ell^{2}(\N) $, defined for all $ x\in\mathbb{T} $ by \begin{equation} (H(x)u)_n = u_{n+1} + u_{n-1} + λf(2^{n} x) u_n, \quad \text{for } n \geq 0,\notag \end{equation} with the Dirichlet boundary condition $ u_{-1}=0 $. Building on Zhang's recent breakthrough work [Comm.Math.Phys.405:231(2024)] that resolved Damanik's open problem [Proc.Sympos.
